source.quote: Income taxes, net of refunds: Federal $ 65 State 46 Foreign 121 Cash paid for income taxes, net of refunds $ 232 [USD millions; FY2025 only]

notes: Fiscal year ended December 31, 2025. Taxes: us-gaap:IncomeTaxesPaidNet, net of refunds, from the ASU 2023-09 table by jurisdiction (federal 65, state 46, foreign 121). R&D not reported as a separate line. Airbnb reports 'Product development' ($2,354 million in 2025; tagged us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense in XBRL), which the 10-K describes as costs of developing the platform without calling it research and development, so it is not recorded.
